description: Reeling: double-barrelled finger guns (index and middle fingers out, thumb up, ring and pinky curled) pointed at each other, the left one held still while the right one circles. Segments, in seconds from the start: forward 1 turn (2.1-3.7); forward 2 turns (4.4-6.9); forward 3 turns (7.5-11.1); forward, faster and bigger or smaller turns (11.9-18.1); backward 1 turn (21.5-23.4); backward 2 turns (23.8-26.2); backward 3 turns (26.6-29.7); backward, faster and bigger or smaller turns (30.1-36.1); both double guns held still (41.7-50.3); left hand a single finger gun, right hand open (50.4-57.5); the right double gun circling on its own (57.8-63.4). The turns are counted as the user made them; there's a pause between each group. Forward is clockwise as seen in the (mirrored) preview. After the third backward turn the hand curls into a small hook as it stops. The near misses at the end shouldn't step. Recorded from a live webcam at 320x240 via HandwaveWidget.hands_data, every other frame (~40 fps); labels are as the tracker sees them. MediaPipe stalled for 5 s at 36.3 s (no frames).
